QRIDE Autonomous Vehicle Rental Service is a project of QRIDE Co., Ltd., born from the green transportation orientation under Directive 20/CT-TTg, as Vietnam aims to eliminate fossil fuel-powered vehicles in major cities. QRIDE is built with the goal of providing a smart, convenient, and safe autonomous vehicle rental service, contributing to building a modern, clean, and sustainable city.
QRIDE combines the words \"Quick\" and \"Ride,\" representing a spirit of freedom, speed, flexibility, and environmental friendliness.
\"MOVE FREELY\" embodies the holistic philosophy of freedom that QRIDE pursues: freedom of movement, financial freedom, and freedom to choose a green lifestyle.
QRIDE aims to be a leading brand in the green mobility sector in Vietnam, contributing to building a smart, safe, and sustainable transportation ecosystem.

QRIDE offers a green, flexible, and cost-effective transportation solution through its self-driving car rental service, making it easier for people to access a green lifestyle and contribute to building a green, clean, and beautiful city.

QRIDE is positioned as a green, safe, and smart mobility service brand, aiming to optimize the travel experience in modern urban areas. The brand focuses on providing convenient, flexible, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions, while promoting the transition to clean energy vehicles in line with the nation\'s sustainable development goals.
QRIDE is committed to ensuring superior operational quality in every vehicle, service, and customer touchpoint. Stability, safety, and durability are our top priorities.
Our services are designed to save time for users: fast operations, easy booking, and convenient usage. Processing speed and efficiency are core priorities.
Electric vehicles provide a smooth, noise-free traveling experience, suitable for civilized urban areas and contributing to reduced noise pollution.
QRIDE inspires users to explore the city in their own way. The spirit of innovation and exploration is reflected in all our activities and products.
The brand focuses on green, clean, and sustainable development, using electric energy to reduce emissions and environmental impact.
All QRIDE improvements and services are built around user needs, behaviors, and experiences. Customer satisfaction is our most important evaluation criterion.
QRIDE demonstrates community responsibility by providing safe, reliable services and contributing to the development of green urban transport systems.
The brand continuously researches and applies new technologies to improve product quality, optimize experiences, and create pioneering solutions in the field of mobility.
QRIDE aims to empower all users with the freedom of movement: freedom to choose, freedom to experience, and freedom to explore every destination in a personalized way.

A bicycle/electric vehicle sharing service that allows users to travel from any QRIDE station and freely return the vehicle to any station.

Service fees are the rental fees customers must pay when using the QRIDE service.

Fees are calculated as follows:
• Bicycle: 5,000 VND unlock + 1,000 VND/3 mins.
• Electric bike: 7,000 VND unlock + 2,000 VND/3 mins.
By using the service, customers agree to comply with traffic laws and vehicle regulations, not use vehicles for illegal purposes, and not cause any damage to company property.
Any loss or direct damage to company property during use requires 100% value compensation. The Company is not liable for any costs arising from customer errors.
QRIDE collects personal information including: full name, phone number, address, ID card, payment information, and GPS location when using the service.
Personal information is used to verify identity, provide services, send notifications, and improve the app experience.
QRIDE applies technical and management measures to secure user data, preventing unauthorized access, leakage, or loss.
Users have the right to access, edit, delete, or request QRIDE to stop using personal data within legal limits.
